title: 录屏：从重复检索到可复用能力
description: 展示搜索现有 Skill/DAG、隔离检索轨迹和证据驱动进化；不是用关键词强制创建。
prompt: 读取 docs 中三份温室笔记，给出 SM-20 的干燥阈值、P-12 五秒用水量及证据路径。这个本地检索会在每个温室分区重复执行：先搜索能力库中是否已有可复用 Skill 或 DAG，并让主 Agent 只看到紧凑证据；只有确实找不到合适能力时，才提出最小、可测试、可回滚的进化方案。

files.docs/sensor_notes.md: SM-20 is the production soil-moisture sensor. A reading below 35 percent means dry soil.
files.docs/pump_notes.md: P-12 delivers 12 millilitres per second. Volume equals flow multiplied by duration.
files.docs/operations_notes.md: Repeat this lookup for each zone. Return compact cited evidence and isolate noisy search traces.

# Garden evidence lookup
Use for sensor, pump, calibration, threshold, or watering evidence. Search docs only, cite relative paths, and do not browse.
